kernels.name: mimo_moe_k1_down

note: L5 fused MoE decode (design-decode-fusion-20261007 2c). Pairs P = routed (token, k) pairs of one wave; M <= 4 tokens -> P <= 32; 48 = max_route_ids. P < 8 passes ids as constant (MLX metal_kernel max_constant_array_size). M4 lever 1 (mimo/m4-attribution): a served wave wider than one token (P > 8: the verify rows) takes the union texts, one read per distinct slot; P <= 8 (every serial call) keeps the banked texts and their template arguments; the banked texts are also the union texts' bitwise reference in the device self-check. K1 (mimo/k1-moe-bw): `decode_moe_kernel: k1` binds the k1 texts at every wave width (MAXM 1 at P <= 8, the union rule at MAXM 4 from P >= 9); per member row the banked texts' arithmetic bit for bit (FMA 0). FMA 1 (one FMA per weight, block scale folded once per lane block) is a rounding-class alternative the m4attr family times; no route binds it.
